name: Gatou Monji
source:
A participant in the Holy Grail War. He is very incompetent, and worships his servant as a god.

His servant is one of the two Berserkers (resembles Arcueid from Tsukihime).

[spoiler]He is one of the members of the student council in Fate extra CCC.[/spoiler]
